تنوزعت (form VI)
# تُنُوزِعْتُ (tunūziʕtu) /tu.nuː.ziʕ.tu/: first-person singular past passive of تَنَازَعَ (tanāzaʕa)
# تُنُوزِعْتَ (tunūziʕta) /tu.nuː.ziʕ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past passive of تَنَازَعَ (tanāzaʕa)
# تُنُوزِعْتِ (tunūziʕti) /tu.nuː.ziʕ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past passive of تَنَازَعَ (tanāzaʕa)
# تُنُوزِعَتْ (tunūziʕat) /tu.nuː.zi.ʕat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
